notes.note: Updated the former long-occurrence refusal description. The server applies the same issued-identity derivation in the install declaration check and the Project pane catalog, and continues to refuse overlong authored descriptors and bound sources.

Reviewed the layout slice against the current stack host, installation gate and Project catalog. Existing manifests keep their descriptor references. Versioned compact occurrence and state identities fit the existing host limit, and old long direct bookmarks bind only to their matching catalog entry.

Documented distinct descriptor, occurrence and state-key responsibilities. Verified that the Project catalog issues the identities consumed by the layout renderer and direct route, and a fitting legacy state key is preserved.

Reviewed the Project navigation and workspace entry, the starter and composer journeys, SDK compatibility and the three Project screenshots. The Project page refreshes its own saved layouts even when the browser restored a successful empty read. A layout-bound pane waits for the live layout answer and reports a layout read problem in its picker. Project creation, composer bindings, Project sections shown in the existing screenshots and independent pane actions retain their prior behavior. A real Coding workspace reloaded from a persisted empty list and opened the changed Git file in one activation at 390px and 1440px.

Reviewed the direct Project Pane entry against the relation, authority, package and hosting references. A former overlong Project layout bookmark is matched against the current caller's catalog entry for the same descriptor, Project and source. The renderer continues to use the catalog-issued current occurrence and existing availability, trust, workspace binding and action checks. Context transfer, private runner and Work Board authorization and the existing frame stay under their current owners.

Reviewed the Project catalog projection and authoring guidance. The catalog keeps fitting instance IDs and state keys and issues SHA-256-derived keys only for overlong composed Project layout occurrences. Descriptor identity, contributor binding, visibility and host limits are preserved. The nine shipped example definitions yielded 19 bounded occurrences with stable repeated reads and distinct Project identities. A previously valid state key at 128 characters was retained.
